title: Knotted Flaky Slovakian Pierogy Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring sour and flaky dumplings, kid-friendly and low in glycemic index, these pierogies are steamed in a leaf wrap and served with a side of cloves, made in a tava griddle.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, warm water, sour cream, egg, salt, and ground cloves, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and fold into a knot, then press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Wrap each dumpling in a leaf wrap and place in a steamer basket.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 10 minutes.
While the dumplings are steaming, melt the butter in a tava griddle over medium heat.
Once the dumplings are cooked, remove them from the steamer and add to the tava griddle, cooking for an additional 2 minutes on each side.
Serve the knotted flaky Slovakian pierogy dumplings hot, garnished with additional ground cloves if desired.
